title: 第326章 师兄哪吒22章有了新人忘旧人呗第325章 师兄哪吒21他喜欢她心疼他的样子
slug: 西游恶人攻略录哪吒总骗我亲他
lines: 陈塘关的晚霞一如既往地好看。
漫天流云被落日晕染成醇厚的橘红，晚风掠过庭院，卷起细碎桂花香，漫过青石地面。
江盼坐在石凳上，指尖捧着一杯热乎乎的芋泥波波奶茶，静静望着天边连绵的晚霞。
哪吒就坐在她身侧，同样捧着一杯同款奶茶，少年安安静静陪着她，没有出声打扰。
庭院落满余晖，四下无声，只剩晚风轻轻流淌。
良久，少年率先打破沉寂。
“姐姐。”
江盼侧头看他。
“你会一直留在陈塘关吗？”
他目光澄澈，直直望着她，眼底藏着一丝不易察觉的忐忑，藏着长久以来藏不住的不安。
江盼咬了咬吸管，眸光柔和：“也许吧。”
“也许？”
哪吒眉头轻轻蹙起，身子微微凑近，“不应该是‘一定’吗？”
江盼忍不住弯眸轻笑：“你这个人，怎么这么贪心。”
“我一点都不贪心。”
哪吒神色无比认真，没有半分玩笑之意，“我只是不想再猜了。”
不想再猜她会不会某一天骤然离去。
不想再猜她心底到底有没有自己。
更不想再猜，每一次陪在她身边的，她喜欢的，在意的到底是灵珠子，还是此刻的自己，亦或是那个阴暗偏执的另一重人格。
江盼怔了一下，心头紧跟着一软，密密麻麻的心疼漫上心口。
“好吧。”
她放下手中奶茶，转过身，认认真真看向他的眼眸，一字一句清晰开口：“一定。
我会一直留下。”
哪吒漆黑的眼眸瞬间亮起细碎星光，眼底的阴郁一扫而空。
可下一秒，他又执着地追问，和从前一模一样：“那我们，什么时候才能变成真的？”
江盼：“……你怎么又提这个。”
“我是认真的。”
少年眼神坦荡，没有半分闪躲。
“我知道你是认真的。”
江盼叹了口气，“但你才三岁。”
“三岁怎么了？”
“三岁不能想这些。”
哪吒沉默了两息：“那几岁能想？”
江盼被他问住了。
她思衬片响，说：“至少……十八？”
哪吒低头算了算：“还有十五年。”
content_en:
The sunset at Chentangguan is as beautiful as ever.
The flowing clouds in the sky were dyed a rich orange red by the setting sun. The evening breeze swept through the courtyard, picking up the fragrance of fine osmanthus and spreading over the bluestone ground.
Jiang Pan sat on the stone bench, holding a cup of hot taro mud Bobo milk tea on his fingertips, quietly looking at the continuous sunset on the horizon.
Nezha was sitting next to her, holding a cup of the same milk tea. The young man stayed with her quietly without disturbing her.
The courtyard was filled with the afterglow, and there was no sound everywhere except for the gentle flow of the evening breeze.
After a long time, the young man took the lead in breaking the silence.
"Sister."
"Huh?"
Jiang Pan looked sideways at him.
"Will you stay in Chentangguan forever?"
He looked straight at her with clear eyes. There was a trace of unnoticeable anxiety in his eyes, hiding the uneasiness that had been hidden for a long time.
Jiang Pan bit the straw, his eyes soft: "Maybe."
"Maybe?"
Nezha frowned slightly and leaned slightly closer, "Shouldn't it be 'certainly'?"
Jiang Pan couldn't help but bend his eyes and chuckle: "Why are you so greedy?"
"I'm not greedy at all."
Nezha's expression was extremely serious, without any hint of joking, "I just don't want to guess anymore."
I don’t want to guess anymore whether she will suddenly leave one day.
I don’t want to guess anymore whether she has herself in her heart.
She didn't even want to guess anymore, whether she liked the person she cared about every time he was with her, whether it was the spirit beads, herself at the moment, or that dark and paranoid other personality.
Jiang Pan was startled for a moment, then his heart softened, and a dense feeling of distress filled his heart.
"Okay."
She put down the milk tea in her hand, turned around, looked seriously into his eyes, and spoke clearly every word: "Definitely.
I will always stay. "
Nezha's dark eyes instantly lit up with tiny stars, and the gloom in his eyes was swept away.
But the next second, he asked persistently, exactly the same as before: "Then when will we become real?"
Jiang Pan: "...why do you mention this again?"
"I'm serious."
The young man's eyes were open and he didn't dodge at all.
"I know you're serious."
Jiang Pan sighed, "But you are only three years old."
"What happened to three years old?"
"Three-year-olds can't think about these things."
Nezha was silent for two breaths: "How old can you think about it?"
Jiang Pan was stunned by his question.
She thought about it and said, "At least...eighteen?"
Nezha lowered his head and calculated: "There are still fifteen years."
